faq.h3: Buying a Hotel in Malaysia — FAQ

items.q: How do I buy a hotel for sale in Malaysia?
items.a: WhatsApp us your preferred location, star rating and budget. Our team shortlists matching undervalued hotels from our database, sends you full financials and photos, and arranges a private site viewing before you commit.

items.q: Are the hotels really below market value?
items.a: Yes. Every listing on our hot list is pre-screened and is typically up to 30% below independent market valuation. We show you the asking price against the market value so the discount is clear.

items.q: What gross yield can I expect from a hotel?
items.a: Our Grade-A hotels for sale fetch a gross rental yield of up to 13% per year. The exact yield depends on the property, location and occupancy — we share the full numbers for each listing.

items.q: Can foreigners buy a hotel in Malaysia?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can own commercial property including hotels in Malaysia, subject to minimum purchase thresholds and state consent. We guide you through the requirements for each property and state.

items.q: Do you have freehold and leasehold hotels?
items.a: Both. Our listings include freehold and leasehold hotels, motels and resorts. The tenure is stated clearly on every listing so you can choose what suits your investment strategy.

items.q: Which areas have the most hotel listings?
items.a: We cover all 14 Malaysian states, with the strongest concentration in Kuala Lumpur, Penang, Johor Bahru, Genting Highlands and Petaling Jaya — but new listings appear nationwide regularly.

items.q: I own a hotel — can you help me sell it?
items.a: Yes. Contact us and we'll match you with potential hotel buyers from our investor network. Many sellers receive serious offers within a few days. There's no obligation to list.

items.q: Is there a fee to see the full hotel listings?
items.a: No. Browsing and enquiring is free. We're a registered estate agency (Vivahomes Realty Sdn Bhd, E(1)1670) and are remunerated through the standard transaction process, not upfront fees from buyers.
